column1: # PLL setups for bench/search.sh: name<TAB>setup<TAB>move group
# Generated from pll-setups.txt. Each line is the setup for a PLL case: applying
# it to a solved cube leaves that case, and the search is asked to undo it. The
# setups are the inverse of the corresponding PLL algorithms, produced by feeding
# each algorithm to the solver (-n 1) and taking its first solution.
# The move group is the set of move types the setup uses: wide turns get their
# own entry (r and R are different moves) and so do rotations. Rotations are
# never required to solve - a whole-cube rotation of the solved cube counts as
# solved, so it never has to be undone - but they are allowed whenever the setup
# Every row was checked to permute only U-layer pieces, with no corner twist, no
# edge flip and no moved centers (up to a whole-cube rotation).
# U-layer corners: 0 UFR, 1 URB, 2 UBL, 3 ULF
# U-layer edges:   0 UF,  1 UR,  2 UB,  3 UL
